exposure: Uterine artery embolization (UAE) for postpartum or postabortion hemorrhage
cohort: 62 women who underwent emergent or prophylactic UAE for postpartum or postabortion hemorrhage between 2008 and 2017
finding: While pregnancy and live birth rates after UAE were acceptable, patients undergoing infertility treatment experienced a higher rate of delivery complications, such as severe adhesion after cesarean section or placenta accreta.
